data.notes: August 2026 in Marbella is anchored by the late-summer Starlite Occident run, with a smaller confirmed Bella Festival date and a dance-pop arena show adding variety beyond the quarry.

events.title: Nile Rodgers & CHIC at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Nile Rodgers & CHIC are confirmed to return to Starlite Occident on Wednesday, 26 August. The official listing highlights CHIC’s disco, pop and dance legacy, with showtime at 22:00.

events.title: Gloria Trevi at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Gloria Trevi is confirmed for Starlite Occident on Monday, 24 August, with a 22:00 Auditorium show. The official page describes it as her only European concert for the year and a career-spanning Latin-pop performance.

events.title: Gente de Zona at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Cuban duo Gente de Zona are confirmed for Starlite Occident on Wednesday, 5 August, with the official page highlighting a set of Latin and Caribbean urban hits. The concert is scheduled for the Auditorium stage at 22:00.

events.title: Black Coffee - Marbella 2026
events.summary: Large-scale open-air Afro house event headlined by Black Coffee, presented by Pedro Caldas and Cipriani Group, with doors from 18:00 and music running until 02:00.

events.title: Rosario at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Rosario is confirmed on Starlite Occident’s Auditorium stage on 1 August, with doors at 20:00 and showtime at 22:00. The festival bills the set around her Spanish pop, rumba, flamenco, funk and bossa-nova repertoire.

events.title: Malú at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Malú is listed on Starlite Occident’s official Marbella 2026 lineup for 10 August. This is a confirmed date within the festival’s August concert programme at the Cantera de Nagüeles.

events.title: Love of Lesbian at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Love of Lesbian are confirmed on Starlite Occident’s official 2026 lineup for 29 August, closing the listed August run. Ticketmaster also lists the Starlite Auditorium show for Saturday, 29 August at 22:00.

events.title: Vanesa Martín at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Vanesa Martín is confirmed for Starlite Occident on Friday, 14 August, with an Auditorium show at 22:00. The official page notes a set mixing new Casa Mía material with career hits.

events.title: Bella Festival 2026
events.summary: Bella Festival’s official site confirms its 2026 edition for Saturday, 1 August at OMA SOUND Marbella, with the first ticket batch on sale. The current official page does not yet list a confirmed 2026 artist lineup.

events.title: Delaossa at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Delaossa is confirmed to make his Starlite Occident debut on Thursday, 6 August. The Málaga rapper brings La Madrugá Tour material to the Auditorium stage at 22:00.

events.title: Álvaro de Luna & Nil Moliner at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Starlite Occident confirms a double bill with Álvaro de Luna and Nil Moliner for Friday, 7 August. The official listing frames both artists as leading names in contemporary Spanish pop.

events.title: KISSTORY Marbella Sundays at NAÔ Pool Club
events.summary: KISSTORY’s Marbella pool-party run at NAÔ, with confirmed August Sunday dates including the 30 August Bank Holiday Special and a soundtrack rooted in old-school R&B, hip-hop, garage and party classics.

events.title: INNA – Echoes Tour
events.summary: INNA’s official tour page confirms Marbella Arena on 22 August for the Echoes Tour. Ticketmaster lists the same date at 19:00 and names DJ Sak Noel as special guest.

events.title: Nueva Soul - The AfroHouse Rooftop Experience: August Residency
events.summary: Sunday Afro house rooftop residency above Puerto Banús, with confirmed August dates on 2, 9, 16, 23 Bank Holiday Special and 30 August Closing Party.

events.title: Afrobeast x Mogli: August Tuesdays
events.summary: Weekly poolside Afrobeats, Amapiano, Hip-Hop and Afro-House party at Mogli, running 12:00-20:00 through the summer season with August Tuesday dates.

events.title: R&B Lovers x Mogli: August Wednesdays
events.summary: Weekly daytime throwback R&B pool party at Mogli, focused on 90s and 00s R&B anthems with DJs in a premium pool-club setting.

events.title: Bad & Boujee at TIBU: August Fridays
events.summary: Friday-night TIBU residency mixing RnB, Hip-Hop, Afrobeat and house, with August dates on 7, 14, 21 and 28 August and residents Jordan Valleys and DJ PM listed.

events.title: The Red Cup Party at TIBU: August Thursdays
events.summary: Weekly Thursday urban club night at TIBU with Hip-Hop, RnB, Afrobeats, UK sounds and Bashment, with August dates on 6, 13, 20 and 27 August.

events.title: Backstage Wednesdays at Pangea Club Marbella
events.summary: Midweek rooftop club night at Pangea blending House, R&B and Afrobeats above the Puerto Banús marina, listed for 22:00-03:00.
